events.title: The updated demo is out now!

We’ve been refining the game, from environments to visual effects, and today we’d like to invite you to try the updated demo!Returning players will notice a few changes. events.title: The new Emptiness Sire demo is here 📣
events.summary: Hey everyone!It’s been a while ⏳ and during this time, we’ve been working hard behind the scenes.Today, we’re excited to share something special with you: the new Emptiness Sire Demo 2.0 is now available.This update brings a refreshed visual direction, a complete UI overhaul, and new puzzles, reflecting how much the game has evolved since the first version. events.title: To everyone supporting Emptiness Sire: thank you!

events.title: When the Forest Starts to Close In
events.summary: Horror doesn’t always come from what you see 👁️ sometimes it’s in what quietly watches back.In Emptiness Sire, the presence of cosmic horror doesn’t rely on jumpscares or grotesque displays. It seeps through the environment itself. Eyes carved into stones, altars hidden between roots, statues of devotion eroded by time… small, almost imperceptible details that suggest something greater, and far older, is observing you.As players move from World 1 to World 2, the forest begins to close in. events.title: Pistons, levers, and what’s coming in World 2
events.summary: Hey everyone!Over the past two weeks, we’ve been deeply focused on finalizing World 2 and refining the ideas for World 3 👁️ and we can already tell these two chapters will feel very different from each other.In World 2, we introduced two new mechanics: pistons and levers. events.title: Mechanics, atmosphere, and what’s coming next in Emptiness Sire
events.summary: Hey everyone!Today we want to share a bit about the mechanics that make Emptiness Sire a unique experience.At its core, our game is a 2D turn-based puzzle. Every move matters and every mistake can (and should) be reconsidered.
